lights.name: Mount Desert
lights.remarks: HORN: 2 blasts ev 30s (2s bl-2s si-2s bl-24s si).

lights.name: Matinicus Rock
lights.remarks: Emergency light of reduced intensity when main light is extinguished. HORN: 1 blast ev 15s (2s bl).

lights.name: Monhegan Island
lights.remarks: Within 3 miles of island the light is obscured between west and southwest. Emergency light of reduced intensity when main light is extinguished.

lights.name: Seguin
lights.remarks: HORN: 2 blasts ev 20s (2s bl-2s si-2s bl-14s si).

lights.name: Halfway Rock
lights.remarks: HORN: 2 blasts ev 30s (2s bl-2s si-2s bl-24s si).

lights.name: Cape Elizabeth
lights.remarks: Lighted throughout 24 hours. Emergency light of reduced intensity when main light is extinguished. HORN: 2 blasts ev 60s (3s bl-3s si-3s bl-51s si). Horn located 266 yards 146° from light tower.

lights.name: Goat Island
lights.remarks: HORN: 1 blast ev 15s (2s bl).

lights.name: Cape Neddick
lights.structure: White conical tower connected to dwelling.
lights.remarks: Lighted throughout 24 hours. Emergency light of reduced intensity when main light is extinguished. HORN: 1 blast ev 10s (1s bl).

lights.name: Boon Island
lights.structure: Gray conical tower connected to dwelling.
lights.remarks: Emergency light of reduced intensity when main light is extinguished. HORN: 1 blast ev 10s (2s bl). Operates continuously.

lights.name: Whaleback
lights.remarks: HORN: 2 blasts ev 30s (2s bl-2s si-2s bl-24s si).

lights.name: Isles of Shoals
lights.remarks: Emergency light of reduced intensity when main light is extinguished. HORN: 1 blast ev 30s (3s bl).

lights.name: Newburyport Harbor
lights.remarks: Obscured by shore structure from 165° to 192° and 313° to 344°.

lights.name: Cape Ann
lights.remarks: Emergency light of reduced intensity when main light is extinguished. HORN: 2 blasts ev 60s (3s bl-3s si-3s bl-51s si).

lights.name: Eastern Point
lights.structure: White conical tower covered way to dwelling.
lights.remarks: Lighted throughout 24 hours. Emergency light of reduced intensity when main light is extinguished.

lights.name: The Graves
lights.structure: On light gray conical granite tower.
lights.remarks: Emergency light of reduced intensity when main light is extinguished. HORN: 2 blasts ev 20s (2s bl-2s si-2s bl-14s si).

lights.name: Boston
lights.remarks: Emergency light of reduced intensity when main light is extinguished. Two emergency lights may be visable from 336° to 001° and from 156° to 181°. HORN: 1 blast ev 30s (3s bl).

lights.name: Minots Ledge
lights.remarks: HORN: 1 blast ev 10s (1s bl).

lights.name: Race Point
lights.remarks: Obscured from 220° to 292°.

lights.name: Highland
lights.remarks: Lighted throughout 24 hours.

lights.name: Chatham
lights.remarks: Lighted throughout 24 hours. Storm warning signals displayed by day.

lights.name: Nantucket (Great Point)
lights.remarks: Red from 084° to 106°. Covers Cross Rip and Tuckernuck Shoals.

lights.name: Sankaty Head
lights.structure: White tower with red band in the middle.

lights.name: Buzzards Bay Entrance
lights.structure: Tower on red square on 3 red piles with large tube in center worded BUZZARDS on sides.
lights.remarks: HORN: 2 blasts ev 30s (2s bl-2s si-2s bl-24s si).

lights.name: Block Island Southeast
lights.structure: Red-brick octagonal pyramidal tower attached to dwelling.
lights.remarks: Lighted throughout 24 hours. Emergency light of reduced intensity when main light is extinguished. Emergency light is offset from main light. HORN: 1 blast ev 30s (3s bl).

lights.name: Montauk Point
lights.structure: White conical tower with red stripe.
lights.remarks: Emergency light Fl W 5s when main light is extinguished. HORN: 1 blast ev 15s (2s bl).

lights.name: West Quoddy Head
lights.remarks: HORN: 2 blasts ev 30s (2s bl-2s si-2s bl-24s si).

lights.name: Little River
lights.remarks: HORN: 1 blast ev 10s (1s bl).

lights.name: Libby Island
lights.remarks: Emergency light of reduced intensity when main light is extinguished. HORN: 1 blast ev 15s (2s bl).

lights.name: Moose Peak
lights.remarks: HORN: 2 blasts ev 30s (2s bl-2s si-2s bl-24s si). Located 129 yards 263° from light tower.

lights.name: Petit Manan
lights.remarks: Emergency light of reduced intensity when main light is extinguished. HORN: 1 blast ev 30s (3s bl).

lights.name: Egg Rock
lights.remarks: HORN: 2 blasts ev 30s (2s bl-2s si-2s bl-24s si).

lights.name: Great Duck Island
lights.remarks: Light partially obscured by trees from about 143° to 206.5°. HORN: 1 blast ev 15s (2s bl).

lights.name: Fort Point
lights.remarks: Lighted throughout 24 hours. HORN: 1 blast ev 10s (1s bl).

lights.name: Browns Head
lights.remarks: Red from 001° to 050° and from 061° to 091° fairway between. Lighted throughout 24 hours. Emergency light of reduced intensity when main light is extinguished. HORN: 1 blast ev 10s (1s bl).

lights.name: Owls Head
lights.remarks: Obscured from 324° to 354° by Monroe Island. Lighted throughout 24 hours. HORN: 2 blast ev 20s (2s bl-2s si-2s bl-14s si).

lights.name: Rockland Harbor Breakwater
lights.remarks: HORN: 1 blast ev 15s (2s bl).

lights.name: Two Bush Island
lights.remarks: Red from 061° to 247°. Emergency light of reduced intensity when main light is extinguished. HORN: 1 blast ev 15s (2s bl).

lights.name: Marshall Point
lights.remarks: Lighted throughout 24 hours. HORN: 1 blast ev 10s (1s bl).

lights.name: The Cuckolds
lights.remarks: HORN: 1 blast ev 15s (2s bl).

lights.name: Portsmouth Harbor (New Castle)
lights.structure: White conical tower fog signal house attached.
lights.remarks: HORN: 1 blast ev 10s (1s bl).

lights.name: Annisquam Harbor
lights.structure: White cylindrical tower; elevated walk to dwelling.
lights.remarks: Red from 180° to 217°. HORN: 2 blasts ev 60s (3s bl-3s si-3s bl-51s si).

lights.name: Plymouth
lights.structure: White octagonal pyramidal tower white dwelling.
lights.remarks: Red from 323° to 352° covers Mary Ann Rocks. Emergency light of reduced intensity when main light is extinguished. HORN: 2 blasts ev 15s (3s bl).

lights.name: West Chop
lights.remarks: Red from 281° to 331° covers Squash Meadow and Norton Shoal. HORN: 1 blast ev 30s (3s bl).

lights.name: Nobska Point
lights.remarks: Obscured from 125° to 195°. Red from 263° to 289° covers Hedge Fence and L`Hommedieu Shoal. Lighted throughout 24 hours. HORN: 2 blasts ev 30s (2s bl-2s si-2s bl-24s si).

lights.name: Cleveland East Ledge
lights.structure: White cylindrical tower and dwelling on red caisson.
lights.remarks: HORN: 1 blast ev 15 (2s bl).

lights.name: Beavertail
lights.structure: Square granite tower attached to white dwelling.
lights.remarks: Obscured from 175° to 215°. Lighted throughout 24 hours. HORN: 1 blast ev 30s (3s bl).

lights.name: Hog Island Shoal
lights.structure: White conical tower on black cylindrical pier.
lights.remarks: HORN: 2 blasts ev 30s (2sbl-2s si-2s bl-24s si).

lights.name: Warwick
lights.remarks: Lighted throughout 24 hours. HORN: 1 blast ev 15s (2s bl).

lights.name: Point Judith
lights.structure: Octagonal tower, lower half white, upper half brown.
lights.remarks: HORN: 1 blast ev 15s (2s bl).

lights.name: Race Rock
lights.structure: Granite tower attached to dwelling on granite pier.
lights.remarks: Horn points southeast. HORN: 2 blasts ev 30s (2s bl-2s si-2s-bl-24s si).

lights.name: Little Gull Island
lights.remarks: HORN: 1 blast ev 15s (2s bl). Operates continuously.

lights.name: Orient Point
lights.structure: Black conical tower with white band in center.
lights.remarks: HORN: 2 blasts ev 30s (2s bl-2s si-2s bl-24s si).

lights.name: Saybrook Breakwater
lights.structure: White conical tower on brown cylindrical pier.
lights.remarks: HORN: 1 blast ev 30s (3s bl).

lights.name: Southwest Ledge
lights.structure: White octagonal house on brown cylindrical pier.
lights.remarks: HORN: 1 blast ev 15s (2s bl).

lights.name: Stratford Point
lights.structure: White conical tower dark red band midway of height.

lights.name: Stratford Shoal (Middle Ground)
lights.structure: Gray granite octagonal tower projection from house on pier.
lights.remarks: HORN: 1 blast ev 15s (2s bl). Operates continuously.

lights.name: Penfield Reef
lights.structure: White tower on granite dwelling on pier.
lights.remarks: HORN: 1 blast ev 15s (2s bl).

lights.name: Execution Rocks
lights.structure: White stone tower, brown band midway of height; granite dwelling attached.

lights.name: New London Harbor
lights.remarks: Red from 000° to 041°. Covers Sarah Ledge and shoals westward.

lights.name: Coney Island
lights.remarks: Lighted throughout 24 hours.

lights.name: Sandy Hook
lights.remarks: Lighted throughout 24 hours.

lights.name: Romer Shoal
lights.structure: Conical tower lower part white upper part brown on black cylindrical pier
lights.remarks: Emergency light of reduced intensity when main light is extinguished. HORN: 2 blasts ev 30s (2s bl-2s si-2s bl-24s si). Operates continuously.
